card.name: Resuming after an interruption
card.fires_on: Words in a sentence about something stopped, suspended or delayed that then resumes or continues. It fires on the subject or verb right before or after the resume, such as session, construction, stays, resumes or returned.

modes.label: Suspended then resumed
modes.description: A process is paused or stopped and the text says it picks up again later.
modes.example: but construction was stopped during the years of the Civil War<<.>> After construction resumed in 186

modes.label: Subject before resume
modes.description: The noun or verb that carries on after a pause, such as a session or activity.
